animation_styles.description: Animation styles to generate (for standard video_producer)

video_formats.description: Video formats to generate. Applies to bar race, intro, audio and merge tasks.

fps.description: Seconds per period for bar_race videos. Controls animation pace - higher = slower/longer video.
fps.tip: fps_hd_offset adds extra seconds for HD only. HD duration = (fps + fps_hd_offset) per period.

fps_hd_offset.description: Extra seconds per period added to HD only. Shorts uses fps, HD uses fps + fps_hd_offset.

use_existing_csv.description: Use existing CSV instead of generating new one. Skips research_data and generate_csv tasks.

use_label_mappings.description: Apply label_mappings.json to shorten bar names (e.g. 'JavaScript' => 'JS'). Set false to use raw CSV column names.

video_enabled.description: Enable standard video generation (uses smart_video_tool with multiple animation styles)

bar_race_video_enabled.description: Enable bar race video generation using bar_race_video_tool with professional interpolation.
bar_race_video_enabled.note: Can be used WITH or WITHOUT video_enabled.

watermark_enabled.description: Overlay semi-transparent watermark text on bar race video frames.

watermark_text.description: Watermark text displayed on video. Usually '@ChannelName'. Change here to update all tools dynamically.

bar_race_audio_enabled.description: Enable audio narration for bar race videos. Independent of audio_enabled.

audio_speed.description: Speech speed for Shorts audio via ffmpeg atempo filter. 1.0=normal, <1.0=slower, >1.0=faster.
audio_speed.tip: 0.8 = slightly slower. Shorts narration is concise so slower speed helps clarity.

audio_speed_hd.description: Speech speed for HD audio ONLY via ffmpeg atempo. Set 0.0 to fall back to audio_speed for both formats.

examples.0.0: No override - HD uses same speed as audio_speed
examples.0.9: Slightly faster than Shorts - good for longer HD narration

audio_speed_hd.tip: HD narration is longer (includes data points). 0.9-1.0 prevents it feeling too slow.

intro_enabled.description: Generate branded intro clip per format. Shows channel name, topic and year range on dark background.

intro_duration.description: Duration of intro clip in seconds.

bar_merge_enabled.description: Concatenate intro_[fmt].mp4 + bar_race_[fmt].mp4 then merge with bar_race_[fmt]_audio.mp3 => Merge_bar_race_[fmt].mp4. Requires all three files to exist.

audio_enabled.description: Enable audio narration for standard (non-bar-race) videos.

merge_audio_video.description: Merge standard audio with standard video files.

generate_youtube_metadata.description: Generate YouTube metadata files (title, description, tags, chapters, cc_en.txt).

channel.description: Channel name used in audio narration ('Welcome to X'), intro clip title, agent backstory, and YouTube metadata. No @ prefix. Change once to update everywhere.

channel_lower.description: Lowercase channel slug used in LinkedIn and other URLs.

website.description: Channel website or primary URL shown in YouTube metadata.
